title: A stable 15-Ah anode-free Li pouch cell enabled by the electron resonance effect
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1577-1589
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06811H, Paper
Shihao Duan, Shuoqing Zhang, Xiaoteng Huang, Haikuo Zhang, Ruhong Li, Long Chen, Jinze Wang, Sheng Dai, Guorong Wang, Feng Guo, Xuezhang Xiao, Huilin Pan, Lixin Chen, Tao Deng, Xiulin Fan
An electron-resonance principle was introduced to direct the interfacial anion reduction process. Electron resonance energy and minimum value of exchange repulsion energy are defined to select the proper diluent.
